title: No bias among senator-judges, part of our job is to test credibility of witnesses-- Win Gatchalian
summary: Senator Sherwin Gatchalian on Sunday dismissed claims that some senator-judges were biased in the impeachment proceedings against Vice President Sara Duterte, saying their role is to assess the…

blocks.text: Senator Sherwin Gatchalian on Sunday dismissed claims that some senator-judges were biased in the impeachment proceedings against Vice President Sara Duterte, saying their role is to assess the credibility of witnesses.

“Kasama 'yan sa trabaho ng senator-judges to test the credibility nung testigo, lalo na may mga testigo na nakakalimot, hindi alam. Wala kang choice to test the credibility at to test kung sino itong taong ito. Ginagawa rin naman 'yun ng Prosekusyon, ginagawa rin naman ng Defense 'yun– pwede ring gawin ng senator-judges 'yun,” Gatchalian told Super Radyo dzBB.

(Part of the senator-judges' job is to test the credibility of witnesses, especially if some forget things or don't know the answers. They have no choice but to test the credibility of the witness and determine who this person is. The Prosecution does it, the Defense does it, and the senator-judges can also do it.)

“Pagdating sa bias, dalawang panig 'yan: pwede kang maging bias for the respondent or against the respondent. Pero nakikita naman natin na as much as possible, 'yung mga senato-judge natin ay objective ang pagtatanong natin,” he added.
(When it comes to bias, you can be biased for or against the respondent. But we can see that, as much as possible, our senator-judges are asking questions objectively.)

Gatchalian made the statement after the Senate impeachment court issued a show-cause order against Duterte’s spokesperson, lawyer Paolo Panelo, over his comments regarding the alleged partiality of several senator-judges.
Panelo had asserted that some senator-judges were acting as prosecutors.
Following the issuance of a show-cause order, Panelo invoked his right to free speech in making critical statements about senator-judges.

"I welcome the opportunity to demonstrate that my comments were fair, made in good faith, and did not impede, obstruct, or degrade the administration of justice, and are thus constitutionally protected," hee said.
Panelo assured that he would formally respond to the show cause order within the prescribed period upon receiving it. —RF, GMA News
